title: Server-supplied notification entity_id concatenated unvalidated into SPA route path
detail: entity_id from the notification payload is interpolated into a modem.push path with no validation. Impact is contained: modem.push is same-origin pushState (no open redirect), the string is never rendered as HTML (no XSS), and vacancy access is enforced server-side. A malformed id degrades to an unmatched route.
recommended_fix: Optionally constrain vid/aid to the id charset (e.g. alphanumeric + hyphen) in notification_target_path before building the path; otherwise document that ids are trusted server-generated values.
